cards.ex: My grandpa is pretty set in his ways; he refuses to use a smartphone.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom odatda o'z odatlarida qat'iy turadi; u smartfondan foydalanishni istamaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z odatlari va qarashlarida qat'iy turadigan, o'zgarishni xohlamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She's such a workaholic; she's always the last one to leave the office.
cards.exUz: U juda ishga berilgan; u har doim ofisdan oxirgi bo'lib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Ishga haddan tashqari berilib ketgan, dam olishni unutgan odam.

cards.ex: After his near-death experience, he decided to just live for the moment.
cards.exUz: O'limga yaqin tajribadan so'ng, u faqat hozirgi payt bilan yashashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakni o'ylamasdan, faqat hozirgi paytdan zavqlanishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's a real social butterfly; she knows everyone at the party.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy ijtimoiy kapalak; u partiyadagi hamma odamni taniydi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p odamlar bilan oson aloqa o'rnatadigan, doimiy ravishda ijtimoiy tadbirlarda qatnashadigan odam.

cards.ex: My roommate is a clean freak; he even vacuums every day!
cards.exUz: Mening xonadoshim tozalikka o'ch; u hatto har kuni changyutgich qiladi!
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari tozalikka e'tibor beradigan, har doim hamma narsani toza saqlashga harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get into the swing of things at my new job.
cards.exUz: Menga yangi ishimga ritmga tushish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.term: get into the swing of things
cards.uzDef: Yangi vaziyatga yoki ishga ko'nikish, uning ritmiga moslashish.

cards.ex: He's such a creature of comfort; he always stays in five-star hotels.
cards.exUz: U shunday qulaylik muxlisi; u har doim besh yulduzli mehmonxonalarda qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Qulaylik va yaxshi sharoitlarni yaxshi ko'radigan, osonlik bilan qiyinchilikka chidamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: Many New Year's resolutions fall by the wayside after a few weeks.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina Yangi yil qarorlari bir necha haftadan keyin unutilib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa asta-sekin unutilib ketishi, bajarilmay qolishi.

cards.ex: She's a total shopaholic; she can't resist a good sale.
cards.exUz: U butunlay xarid qilishga o'ch; u yaxshi chegirmalarga qarshi tura olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Xarid qilishga haddan tashqari berilgan, kerak yoki kerakmasligini o'ylamasdan narsalar sotib oladigan odam.

cards.ex: I was exhausted, but after a coffee, I got a second wind and finished the project.
cards.exUz: Men charchagandim, lekin bir finjon qahva ichgandan keyin, men ikkinchi nafas oldim va loyihani tugatdim.
cards.uzDef: Charchoqdan keyin yangi kuch va energiya topish.

cards.ex: I'm tired of the daily grind; I need a vacation.
cards.exUz: Men kundalik mashaqqatdan charchadim; menga ta'til kerak.
cards.uzDef: Har kuni takrorlanadigan, zerikarli va mashaqqatli ishlar.

cards.ex: He always goes against the grain, which makes him a very interesting person.
cards.exUz: U har doim oqimga qarshi boradi, bu uni juda qiziqarli insonga aylantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Odatga, umumiy fikrga yoki qoidaga zid harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's such a health nut; she only eats organic food.
cards.exUz: U juda sog'lom ovqatlanish muxlisi; u faqat organik ovqatlarni iste'mol qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lig'iga haddan tashqari e'tibor beradigan, faqat sog'lom ovqatlar iste'mol qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: My grandmother always said, 'Early to bed, early to rise, makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.'
cards.exUz: Mening buvim har doim: 'Erta yotib, erta turish odamni sog'lom, boy va dono qiladi', der edi.
cards.term: early to bed, early to rise
cards.uzDef: Erta uxlash va erta turish yaxshi odat ekanligini anglatuvchi maqol.

cards.ex: As a teacher, it's important to set a good example for your students.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi sifatida o'quvchilaringizga yaxshi namuna ko'rsatish muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga o'rnak bo'ladigan, yaxshi xulq-atvor ko'rsatadigan odam bo'lish.

cards.ex: Many artists live from hand to mouth, struggling to make ends meet.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina rassomlar kun ko'rishadi, qiyinchilik bilan ro'zg'or tebratishadi.
cards.uzDef: Ozgina pul topish va darhol uni sarflash, hech qanday jamg'arma qilmasdan yashash.

cards.ex: She broke the mold by becoming a successful female engineer in a male-dominated field.
cards.exUz: U erkaklar hukmron bo'lgan sohada muvaffaqiyatli ayol muhandis bo'lish orqali stereotipni buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan farqli, yangicha usulda harakat qilish, stereotiplarga qarshi chiqish.

cards.ex: I have a sweet tooth, so I can never resist dessert.
cards.exUz: Men shirinlikka o'chman, shuning uchun men hech qachon desertga qarshi tura olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Shirinliklarni juda yaxshi ko'rish, ularni iste'mol qilishni xohlash.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get into the habit of exercising every morning.
cards.exUz: Men har kuni ertalab mashq qilish odatiga kirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani doimiy ravishda bajarish odatiga kirish.

cards.ex: I'm a bit of a homebody; I prefer to stay in on weekends.
cards.exUz: Men biroz uyda o'tiradigan odamman; men dam olish kunlarida uyda qolishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Uyda vaqt o'tkazishni afzal ko'radigan, tashqariga chiqishni xohlamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: It's important to live within your means to avoid financial problems.
cards.exUz: Moliyaviy muammolarni oldini olish uchun imkoniyatingizga qarab yashash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Daromadingizga mos ravishda xarajat qilish, qarzga botmaslik.

cards.ex: The CEO's speech set the tone for the company's new direction.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktorning nutqi kompaniyaning yangi yo'nalishi uchun ohangni belgiladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning umumiy kayfiyatini yoki xarakterini o'rnatish.

cards.ex: I'm trying to quit smoking, but old habits die hard.
cards.exUz: Men chekishni tashlashga harakat qilyapman, lekin eski odat qiyin tashlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Eski odatlardan voz kechish qiyin ekanligini anglatuvchi maqol.

cards.ex: I got a taste of what it's like to be a musician when I played in a band for a summer.
cards.exUz: Men yozda guruhda o'ynaganimda musiqachi bo'lish nimani anglatishini bilib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qisqacha sinab ko'rish, birinchi taassurot olish.

cards.ex: She's a total fashion victim; she buys whatever the magazines tell her to.
cards.exUz: U butunlay moda qurboni; u jurnallar nima desa, shuni sotib oladi.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi moda yo'nalishlariga ko'r-ko'rona ergashadigan, o'z uslubiga ega bo'lmagan odam.

cards.ex: They're always trying to keep up with the Joneses, buying expensive cars and houses.
cards.exUz: Ular har doim qo'shnilarga havas qilib, qimmatbaho mashinalar va uylar sotib olishga harakat qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shnilarga yoki boshqalarga o'xshash narsalarni sotib olish, ulardan ortda qolmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm going out on a limb here, but I think we should invest in this new technology.
cards.exUz: Men bu yerda tavakkal qilyapman, lekin menimcha biz ushbu yangi texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farqli fikrni himoya qilish, xavfli harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's a real culture vulture; she goes to the opera every week.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy madaniyat shinavandasi; u har hafta operaga boradi.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyat tadbirlariga (konsertlar, teatrlar, muzeylar) katta qiziqish bilan qatnashadigan odam.

cards.ex: The hotel provides all the creature comforts you could need for a relaxing stay.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona dam olish uchun kerak bo'ladigan barcha qulayliklarni taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotni qulay qiladigan narsalar: qulay mebel, yaxshi ovqat, qulay sharoit.

cards.ex: I've developed a taste for spicy food since traveling to Asia.
cards.exUz: Osiyoga sayohat qilganimdan beri men achchiq ovqatga ishtiyoq paydo qildim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qiziqish yoki istak asta-sekin paydo bo'lish.
